== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early card keeps characters present in play and says they must forfeit for 0 at battle end. The 2006 response uses your character in battle, replaces early loss with loss at end, and says forfeit 0 if forfeited. It also distinguishes non-Permanent-Weapon characters from characters without any weapons for Bad Feeling Have I and specifies modification of deploy cost. Deploy-on-table and Alter immunity stay.
